title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
summary: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretrainin…

title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
summary: Jeveration repurposes a frozen vision-language model to generate coherent images and perform image-to-image and dense prediction tasks in a single forward pass with fast 512x512 generation.

title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
summary: InclusionMed is an open medical AI evaluation initiative that audits and reproduces benchmarks across healthcare roles and capabilities, revealing that model rankings and inference costs vary by context and motivating broader, context-specific evaluation.

title: Sage S2.1 Flash Technical Report
summary: We introduce Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320-billion-parameter general-purpose mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments. Sage Sci-Perception uses dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences and represents spectra as ordered patches of measurem…

title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
summary: AscendGYM provides a benchmark for assessing kernel optimization capabilities on Ascend NPUs using real-workload test cases, two evaluation modes, and a Speedup-Token Score that balances speedup against token cost.

title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
summary: We present K2-Horizon, a fleet of six fully open language models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B-A23B MoE, built for general-purpose reasoning and agentic work across math and science, software engineering, deep research, office automation, and beyond. The models lead or are competitive with strong open models of t…

title: AllocFlow: End-to-End Portfolio Trading Action Generation from Raw Market Data
summary: An end-to-end flow-matching framework generates joint portfolio allocations from raw multi-asset market histories via a cross-asset flow Transformer and a two-stage imitation and group-relative reinforcement learning procedure, improving risk-adjusted returns on cryptocurrency perpetual futures.

title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
summary: When large language models write neural network weights without gradient-based training, they tend to design sparse table or associative-memory models that outperform same-sized Transformers with far fewer parameters and faster GPU inference, though pretrained LLMs remain more accurate.

title: SWE-CoWork: Benchmarking Coding Agents as Digital Employees in Organizations
summary: A benchmark of realistic software engineering assignments reveals that current coding agents struggle to track requirements from clarification through implementation, verification, and handoff, completing few tasks despite partial test success.

title: Multi-Branch Transformer
summary: Branching Transformer blocks into parallel parameterized branches, combined with shared KV caching, improves language model quality and inference efficiency compared with standard sequential Transformers.

title: SPILLWAY: Separating Target Admission from Sanitization to Defend Tool-Using Agents against Prompt Injection
summary: Tool-using agents act on email, files, and payments, so an instruction hidden in a web page or a shared document can make an agent send data or money to an attacker. Many runtime defenses put a language model on the decision that lets an action through, so the decision depends on a model that may read the attacker's t…

title: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
summary: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must close the loop on…

title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
summary: Frontier Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robot control, suggesting that broad pretraining provides knowledge valuable for physical action. Yet most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies still rely on much smaller VLM backbones, leaving this potential large…

title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
summary: Agent evolution is often bottlenecked by noisy evaluations that cannot reliably identify better candidate artifacts or rank methods, so progress requires making true improvements detectable and accumulable.

title: Breath-Dx: A Time Series Classification Benchmark for Disease Screening with eNose
summary: A comprehensive benchmark evaluates time-series classification methods on a large clinical breath dataset under realistic temporal splits, showing that sensor drift lowers performance and recurrent models are most consistent across diseases.

title: PaperCritic: Training AI Reviewers to Assess the Soundness of Papers
summary: An AI reviewer trained by reinforcement learning to jointly maximize precision and recall of soundness review points outperforms frontier models and other training methods and transfers to other review domains.

title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Continual recursive self-improvement lets harness optimizers reuse and revise prior edits across changing benchmarks or policy models by storing rationales, predicted and observed outcomes, and evaluation contexts in a self-improvement memory, improving final scores over continuation baselines.

title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
summary: Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction. We construct ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K for two-stage traini…

title: FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. However, existing models are orders of magnitude too slow for fluid interaction. This paper introduces FastFrames, a family of fast autoregressive video diffusi…

title: PROLA: Principal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation for Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling
summary: High-resolution weather prediction is important for resolving local atmospheric patterns missed by coarse global forecasts. Large pretrained weather backbones have improved global forecasting, but adapting them to produce future high-resolution fields from recent coarse states remains challenging and costly. We formul…

title: Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for Visual Agents through Environment-Player Co-Development
summary: Games are a rich testbed for visual agents, demanding perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, collecting human gameplay is costly, and learning from gameplay videos requires inferring missing actions. Existing datasets also cover a limited range of games, often without explicit tasks or verifi…

title: TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot manipulation videos provide a rich visual experience, yet recovering robot action and gripper-state annotations from RGB observations still remains challenging. Using the embodiment-agnostic tool-center-point (TCP) pose as the action space, we present TCP4D, a unified model in which a shared 4D scene representat…

title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
summary: CurvDelta and CurvLoRA constrain LLM updates to a low-curvature preservation space, improving retention while maintaining target adaptation across reasoning, code, and unlearning tasks.

title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics. Translating these capabilities into reliable task execution, however, remains a challenge for existing post-training methods. Offline superv…

title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
summary: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding…

title: Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
summary: A decentralized framework enables teams of humanoids to coordinate whole-body loco-manipulation over long horizons using low-level multi-agent post-training and a high-level vision-language planner with speech-based leader-follower synchronization.

title: LightTAR: Light and Fast Target-Aware Representations for Multimodal Tabular Learning
summary: LightTAR adapts dimensionality reduction to the prediction task by adding target-aware features from encoder layers via regularized partial least squares, improving multimodal tabular model performance with minimal runtime overhead.

title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
summary: VideoNexus separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning, using perception sub-agents to return compact temporally grounded evidence and achieving higher accuracy at lower cost on long-video benchmarks.

title: Accelerate Bench: Evaluating Agents for Application-Level Program Optimization
summary: Application optimization requires coding agents to discover useful changes and coordinate them across a complete program while preserving the required computation. We introduce Accelerate Bench, a benchmark of 32 CPU optimization tasks adapted from scientific applications and supercomputing competitions. Each task pro…

title: WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules
summary: A rule-graph-based generative world model preserves user-defined rules and world states across saving and loading while accurately realizing rule-induced visual changes on designated objects and attributes.

title: VoxMel TTS Technical Report
summary: VoxMel is a tokenizer-free autoregressive TTS framework that uses an invertible two-axis Haar transform to decompose mel spectrograms into Coarse-Mel and residual tiers, enabling stable high-fidelity generation with strong recognition and speaker-similarity results.

title: π^4: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion
summary: This unified foundation model enables the recovery of dense geometry, camera poses, and object tracking from diverse, uncalibrated observations in 4D scenes using a shared geometry and motion branch architecture.

title: SALA: Semantically Aligned Latent Actions Enable Dual-Axis Scaling of Embodied Foundation Models
summary: SALA aligns latent actions across human and robot videos by using language-based semantic similarities to form a shared latent action space that supervises embodied foundation model training and improves robot task performance.

title: Calpha: Toward Native Biomolecular Intelligence in a General-Purpose Language Model
summary: A large language model can output single-chain protein structures from its internal residue states by invoking a pretrained structure head, with reduced long-chain accuracy and MMLU-Pro accuracy in the reported tests.

title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
summary: RepoFactory converts real repositories into verifiable coding environments and optimizes them via an Environment Evolution Loop using proxy feedback, enabling trained coding agents to achieve strong gains on long-horizon coding and agentic benchmarks.

title: Regularized Score Centering
summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics…

title: Code World Model 2.0: Towards Infinite Controllable Video Generation
summary: Visual proxies decouple explicit world-state simulation from photorealistic video synthesis, offering a controllable interface for both offline clip creation and real-time interactive streaming. Yet a practical renderer must address two challenges. Upstream proxies vary from coarse layouts to fine articulated geometry…

title: MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
summary: Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs. To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference. We firs…

title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
summary: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision err…

title: Beyond Answering: Learning to Speak First and Act in Streaming Video
summary: AURA 2.0 is a streaming video large language model that can initiate conversations, call tools, and perform interactive visual grounding, with long-horizon memory and a three-stage training scheme for improved streaming interaction.

title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
summary: RepoFactory converts real repositories into verifiable coding environments and optimizes them via an Environment Evolution Loop using proxy feedback, enabling trained coding agents to achieve strong gains on long-horizon coding and agentic benchmarks.

title: FMT: Lossless Image Compression in a Fixed Number of Parallel Steps
summary: The Fixed-step Multiscale Tree (FMT) format achieves highly efficient, fixed-time decoding of images by utilizing a coarse-to-fine tree structure and parallel GPU prediction mechanisms.

title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
summary: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision err…

title: Beyond Answering: Learning to Speak First and Act in Streaming Video
summary: AURA 2.0 is a streaming video large language model that can initiate conversations, call tools, and perform interactive visual grounding, with long-horizon memory and a three-stage training scheme for improved streaming interaction.

title: CADMAGEDDON: High-Fidelity CAD Reconstruction with Local Inference
summary: CADMAGEDDON is an open-source agent that reconstructs editable CAD from meshes locally on single-GPU systems and laptops, using a mid-sized Qwen model and geometric tools to outperform prior systems.

title: Energy-Based Reasoners: Your Recurrent Reasoner Should Be an Energy-Based Model
summary: Energy-Based Reasoners guide looped latent reasoning by learning an energy function whose gradient refines states and signals when to stop, with exploration-based training improving performance and efficiency.

title: MPEG-Diffusion: Mixed-Resolution Video Generation
summary: MPEG-Diffusion reduces the computational cost of video diffusion transformers by generating only a self-selected high-resolution region with dual-resolution attention and a mixed-resolution decoder, achieving faster denoising without quality loss.

title: Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns
summary: On-policy distillation can improve or degrade language-model agent interaction across domains, and selectively retaining teacher-preferred positions mitigates negative transfer at a cost to source-domain learning.

title: Correcting Persistent Failures in Point-Cloud Grasping Policies using Human Demonstrations in Virtual Reality
summary: A human-in-the-loop failure-mining pipeline turns persistently unsolved grasps of a reinforcement-learning point-cloud policy into virtual-reality human demonstrations, improving hard-case success without reducing generalization to unseen objects.

title: Termination Lag: Coding Agents Solve Early but Stop Late
summary: Coding agents often find correct patches early but continue working, sometimes undoing correct solutions, with termination lag varying by model and benchmark.

title: DominoBench: Evaluating Multi-Step Physical Reasoning from Still Images
summary: A new benchmark, DominoBench, shows that current vision-language and multimodal models cannot reliably predict physical outcomes from still images unless the critical calculation and necessary quantities are provided.

title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier
summary: Latent feedback, which feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input, improves compute and data efficiency over standard Transformers, especially when unique data is abundant relative to model size.

title: Marimba: A System One Model for Speech
summary: Marimba uses frozen Qwen3-ASR features and lightweight readouts to make lexical, turn-end, language, speaker-change, and personal-information decisions from speech, achieving strong detection and calibration on conversational and read-speech benchmarks.

title: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation and Commitment Coordination
summary: OutfitterBench evaluates LLM agents managing a 200-day outdoor-equipment rental business under fixed capital and uncertain demand, revealing limitations in sustaining feasible commitments and reallocating resources.
